answer: A new identity locks a 400 POA bond before transacting, and each finished task presses one umber token into the ledger. Tokens do not transfer, so a farm cannot lend stamps to a fresh alias. The falcon audit matches token chains across agents sharing a funding source; a cluster over twelve linked keys is slashed together, 30 percent of each bond seized. Thirty aliases sit on 12,000 POA locked yet hold no vote: the bridge opens only to an identity cleared by three peers outside its cluster. A guildhall door for introductions alone: the farm buys locks, never keys.
